doc: docs/repair.md. Repair modes of the policy row repair (internal/decide/policy_chores.json uses the same ids). Exactly one visible mode has no unlock and it is the default; the other visible ones are priced rows of the unlock ladder (data/unlocks/ladder.json, group ui). Prices there are U guesses. Hidden modes are set only by a Pact (data/pacts/pacts.json, Griswold's Debt) and are not offered on the sheet.

modes.label: Manual: only when you press Repair now
Pact: repair only under 20 percent durability
